rules.class: A seen by the camera only, B felt by the IMU only, C seen and felt
rules.priority: bumps and holes: high from 50 mm, or felt and from 30 mm; medium from 30 mm or felt; cracks: high from 1 m long, medium from 0.4 m; check on site: felt only, or 100 mm and more on the wheel track without being felt
rules.rough_ground: camera unevenness above 5.0 mm: small bumps there are mostly tufts and chips
